hypotheses.rationale: The planner incorrectly calculated the mass of one liter of feathers using a density (~1.3 g/cm³) significantly higher than that of iron (~7.8 g/cm³). This fundamental error in physical constants led to the wrong conclusion (D instead of B), and the task terminated immediately without any verification step to cross-check these values.
